**Before filing, please read the [Non-goals](/README.md#non-goals) section of the README.**

This is a personal, single-route project. It intentionally does not have —
and issues asking for these will be closed as out of scope:

- a station picker (stations are hardcoded per deploy)
- GPS / location awareness
- bus or tram departures
- an iOS app
- support for more than one commute route at a time

If your issue isn't one of the above, please describe it below.
